description: Version 1.1.0 of a foundational preprint proposing Boundary-State Calculus as a typed mathematical audit calculus for claims that move between scientific descriptions. This release adds certified normalized-scale families, logarithmic-rate and singular-set theorems, analytic zero-transfer and exact-decision bounds, a Riemann-zeta and dynamical-quantum-phase-transition instance, nine mathematical fixtures, and one retained deterministic execution receipt. The work is not a fundamental ontology, a unified physical theory, a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, a complete reference implementation, or a peer-reviewed result.
title: On Boundaries of Evidence — Boundary-State Calculus for Typed Observation, Admissible Transfer, and Falsifiable Persistence
